traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἀπέθανεν Ἀβιὰ μετὰ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ , καὶ ἔθαψαν αὐτὸν ἐν πόλει Δαυεὶδ · καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Ἀσὰ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντ᾽ αὐτοῦ . ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ἀσὰ ἡσύχασεν ἡ γῆ Ἰούδα ἔτη δέκα .

1.english_reference: And Asa did [ that which was ] good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God :

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֤עַשׂ אָסָא֙ הַ טּ֣וֹב וְ הַ יָּשָׁ֔ר בְּ עֵינֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי ו
traditions.VUL: Fecit autem Asa quod bonum et plácitum erat in conspéctu Dei sui , et subvértit altária peregríni cultus , et excélsa .
traditions.KJV: And Asa did [ that which was ] good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God :

2.english_reference: For he took away the altars of the strange [ gods ] , and the high places ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֛סַר אֶת מִזְבְּח֥וֹת הַ נֵּכָ֖ר וְ הַ בָּמ֑וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ καλὸν καὶ τὸ εὐθὲς ἐνώπιον Κυρίου θεοῦ αὐτοῦ .
traditions.KJV: For he took away the altars of the strange [ gods ] , and the high places ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְשַׁבֵּר֙ אֶת הַ מַּצֵּב֔וֹת
traditions.VUL: Et confrégit státuas ,
traditions.KJV: and brake down the images ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְגַדַּ֖ע אֶת הָ אֲשֵׁרִֽים
traditions.VUL: lucósque succídit :
traditions.KJV: and cut down the groves :

3.english_reference: And commanded Judah to seek the LORD God of their fathers ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לִֽ יהוּדָ֔ה לִ דְר֕וֹשׁ אֶת יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתֵי הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπέστησεν τὰ θυσιαστήρια τῶν ἀλλοτρίων καὶ τὰ ὑψηλά , καὶ συνέτριψεν τὰς στήλας καὶ ἐξέκοψεν τὰ ἄλση ,
traditions.VUL: et præcépit Iudæ ut quǽreret Dóminum Deum patrum suórum ,
traditions.KJV: And commanded Judah to seek the LORD God of their fathers ,

3.english_reference: and to do the law and the commandment .

traditions.WLC: וְ לַ עֲשׂ֖וֹת הַ תּוֹרָ֥ה וְ הַ מִּצְוָֽה
traditions.VUL: et fáceret legem , et univérsa mandáta :
traditions.KJV: and to do the law and the commandment .

4.english_reference: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images :

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֨סַר֙ מִ כָּל עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה אֶת הַ בָּמ֖וֹת וְ אֶת הַֽ חַמָּנִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν τῷ Ἰούδᾳ ἐκζητῆσαι τὸν κύριον θεὸν τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν καὶ ποιῆσαι τὸν νόμον καὶ τὰς ἐντολάς .
traditions.VUL: et ábstulit de cunctis úrbibus Iuda aras , et fana ,
traditions.KJV: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images :

4.english_reference: and the kingdom was quiet before him .

traditions.WLC: וַ תִּשְׁקֹ֥ט הַ מַּמְלָכָ֖ה לְ פָנָֽי ו
traditions.VUL: et regnávit in pace .
traditions.KJV: and the kingdom was quiet before him .

5.english_reference: And he built fenced cities in Judah :

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּ֛בֶן עָרֵ֥י מְצוּרָ֖ה בִּ יהוּדָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπέστησεν ἀπὸ πασῶν τῶν πόλεων Ἰούδα τὰ θυσιαστήρια καὶ τὰ εἴδωλα , καὶ εἰρήνευσεν .
traditions.VUL: Ædificávit quoque urbes munítas in Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: And he built fenced cities in Judah :

5.english_reference: for the land had rest , and he had no war in those years ;

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי שָׁקְטָ֣ה הָ אָ֗רֶץ וְ אֵין עִמּ֤ וֹ מִלְחָמָה֙ בַּ שָּׁנִ֣ים הָ אֵ֔לֶּה
traditions.VUL: quia quiétus erat , et nulla tempóribus eius bella surréxerant ,
traditions.KJV: for the land had rest , and he had no war in those years ;

5.english_reference: because the LORD had given him rest .

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי הֵנִ֥יחַ יְהוָ֖ה לֽ וֹ
traditions.VUL: pacem Dómino largiénte .
traditions.KJV: because the LORD had given him rest .

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר לִֽ יהוּדָ֜ה
traditions.VUL: Dixit autem Iudæ :
traditions.KJV: Therefore he said unto Judah ,

traditions.WLC: נִבְנֶ֣ה אֶת הֶ עָרִ֣ים הָ אֵ֗לֶּה
traditions.LXX: πόλεις τειχήρεις ἐν γῇ Ἰούδα ,
traditions.VUL: Ædificémus civitátes istas ,
traditions.KJV: Let us build these cities ,

6.english_reference: and make about [ them ] walls , and towers , gates , and bars ,

traditions.WLC: וְ נָסֵ֨ב חוֹמָ֣ה וּ מִגְדָּלִים֮ דְּלָתַ֣יִם וּ בְרִיחִים֒
traditions.VUL: et vallémus muris , et roborémus túrribus , et portis , et seris ,
traditions.KJV: and make about [ them ] walls , and towers , gates , and bars , [ while ]

6.english_reference: [ while ] the land [ is ] yet before us ;

traditions.WLC: עוֹדֶ֨ נּוּ הָ אָ֜רֶץ לְ פָנֵ֗י נוּ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι εἰρήνευσεν ἡ γῆ ·
traditions.VUL: donec a bellis quiéta sunt ómnia ,
traditions.KJV: the land [ is ] yet before us ;

6.english_reference: because we have sought the LORD our God ,

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י דָרַ֨שְׁנוּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔י נוּ
traditions.VUL: eo quod quæsiérimus Dóminum Deum patrum nostrórum ,
traditions.KJV: because we have sought the LORD our God ,

traditions.WLC: דָּרַ֕שְׁנוּ
traditions.KJV: we have sought [ him ] ,

6.english_reference: and he hath given us rest on every side .

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֥נַֽח לָ֖ נוּ מִ סָּבִ֑יב
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἦν αὐτῷ πόλεμος ἐν τοῖς ἔτεσιν τούτοις , ὅτι κατέπαυσεν αὐτῷ Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: et déderit nobis pacem per gyrum .
traditions.KJV: and he hath given us rest on every side .

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּבְנ֖וּ וַ יַּצְלִֽיחוּ
traditions.VUL: Ædificavérunt ígitur , et nullum in exstruéndo impediméntum fuit .
traditions.KJV: So they built and prospered .

7.english_reference: And Asa had an army [ of men ] that bare targets and spears ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֣י לְ אָסָ֗א חַיִל֮ נֹשֵׂ֣א צִנָּ֣ה וָ רֹמַח֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν τῷ Ἰούδᾳ Οἰκοδομήσωμεν τάς πόλεις ταύτας , καὶ ποιήσωμεν τείχη καὶ πύργους καὶ πύλας καὶ μοχλούς ,
traditions.VUL: Hábuit autem Asa in exércitu suo portántium scuta et hastas
traditions.KJV: And Asa had an army [ of men ] that bare targets and spears ,

7.english_reference: out of Judah three hundred thousand ;

traditions.WLC: מִֽ יהוּדָה֙ שְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אֶ֔לֶף
traditions.VUL: de Iuda trecénta míllia ,
traditions.KJV: out of Judah three hundred thousand ;

7.english_reference: and out of Benjamin , that bare shields and drew bows , two hundred and fourscore thousand :

traditions.WLC: וּ מִ בִּנְיָמִ֗ן נֹשְׂאֵ֤י מָגֵן֙ וְ דֹ֣רְכֵי קֶ֔שֶׁת מָאתַ֥יִם וּ שְׁמוֹנִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף
traditions.VUL: de Béniamin vero scutariórum et sagittariórum ducénta octogínta míllia :
traditions.KJV: and out of Benjamin , that bare shields and drew bows , two hundred and fourscore thousand :

7.english_reference: all these [ were ] mighty men of valour .

traditions.WLC: כָּל אֵ֖לֶּה גִּבּ֥וֹרֵי חָֽיִל
traditions.LXX: ἐνώπιον τῆς γῆς κυριεύσομεν · ὅτι καθὼς ἐζητήσαμεν Κύριον θεὸν ἡμῶν , ἐξεζήτησεν ἡμᾶς , καὶ κατέπαυσεν ἡμᾶς κυκλόθεν καὶ εὐόδωσεν ἡμῖν .
traditions.VUL: omnes isti viri fortíssimi .
traditions.KJV: all these [ were ] mighty men of valour .

8.english_reference: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּצֵ֨א אֲלֵי הֶ֜ם זֶ֣רַח הַ כּוּשִׁ֗י בְּ חַ֨יִל֙ אֶ֣לֶף אֲלָפִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο τῷ Ἀσὰ δύναμις ὁπλοφόρων αἰρόντων θυρεοὺς καὶ δόρατα ἐν γῇ Ἰούδα τριακόσιαι χιλιάδες , καὶ ἐν γῇ Βενιαμεὶν πελτασταὶ καὶ τοξόται διακόσιαι καὶ πεντήκοντα χιλιάδες , πάντες οὗτοι πολεμισταὶ δυνάμεως .
traditions.VUL: Egréssus est autem contra eos Zara Æthiops cum exércitu suo , décies centéna míllia ,
traditions.KJV: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand ,

traditions.WLC: וּ מַרְכָּב֖וֹת שְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת
traditions.VUL: et cúrribus trecéntis :
traditions.KJV: and three hundred chariots ;

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹ֖א עַד מָרֵשָֽׁה
traditions.VUL: et venit usque Marésa .
traditions.KJV: and came unto Mareshah .

9.english_reference: Then Asa went out against him ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּצֵ֥א אָסָ֖א לְ פָנָ֑י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐπ᾽ αὐτοὺς Ζάρε ὁ Αἰθίοψ ἐν δυνάμει ,
traditions.VUL: Porro Asa perréxit óbviam ei ,
traditions.KJV: Then Asa went out against him ,

9.english_reference: and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah .

traditions.WLC: ו וַ יַּֽעַרְכוּ֙ מִלְחָמָ֔ה בְּ גֵ֥יא צְפַ֖תָה לְ מָרֵשָֽׁה
traditions.LXX: ἐν χιλιάσιν καὶ ἅρμασιν τριακοσίοις , καὶ ἦλθεν ἕως Μαρισήλ .
traditions.VUL: et instrúxit áciem ad bellum in valle Séphata , quæ est iuxta Marésa :
traditions.KJV: and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah .

11.english_reference: So the LORD smote the Ethiopians before Asa , and before Judah ;

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּגֹּ֤ף יְהוָה֙ אֶת הַ כּוּשִׁ֔ים לִ פְנֵ֥י אָסָ֖א וְ לִ פְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐβόησεν Ἀσὰ πρὸς Κύριον θεὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν Κύριε , οὐκ ἀδυνατεῖ παρὰ σοὶ σώζειν ἐν πολλοῖς καὶ ἐν ὀλίγοις ·
traditions.VUL: Extérruit ítaque Dóminus Æthíopes coram Asa et Iuda :
traditions.KJV: So the LORD smote the Ethiopians before Asa , and before Judah ;

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּנֻ֖סוּ הַ כּוּשִֽׁים
traditions.LXX: κατίσχυσον ἡμᾶς , Κύριε ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν , ὅτι ἐπὶ σοὶ πεποίθαμεν , καὶ ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί σου ἤλθαμεν ἐπὶ τὸ πλῆθος τὸ πολὺ τοῦτο · Κύριε ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν , μὴ κατισχυσάτω πρὸς σὲ ἄνθρωπος .
traditions.VUL: fugerúntque Æthíopes .
traditions.KJV: and the Ethiopians fled .

12.english_reference: And Asa and the people that [ were ] with him pursued them unto Gerar :

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּרְדְּפֵ֨ ם אָסָ֜א וְ הָ עָ֣ם אֲשֶׁר עִמּ וֹ֮ עַד לִ גְרָר֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπάταξεν Κύριος τοὺς Αἰθίοπας ἐναντίον Ἰούδα ,
traditions.VUL: Et persecútus est eos Asa , et pópulus , qui cum eo erat , usque Gerára :
traditions.KJV: And Asa and the people that [ were ] with him pursued them unto Gerar :

12.english_reference: and the Ethiopians were overthrown , that they could not recover themselves ;

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּפֹּ֤ל מִ כּוּשִׁים֙ לְ אֵ֣ין לָ הֶ֣ם מִֽחְיָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔφυγον Αἰθίοπες ,
traditions.VUL: et ruérunt Æthíopes usque ad interneciónem ,
traditions.KJV: and the Ethiopians were overthrown , that they could not recover themselves ;

12.english_reference: for they were destroyed before the LORD , and before his host ;

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי נִשְׁבְּר֥וּ לִ פְנֵֽי יְהוָ֖ה וְ לִ פְנֵ֣י מַחֲנֵ֑ הוּ
traditions.VUL: quia Dómino cædénte contríti sunt , et exércitu illíus prœliánte .
traditions.KJV: for they were destroyed before the LORD , and before his host ;

12.english_reference: and they carried away very much spoil .

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׂא֥וּ שָׁלָ֖ל הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד
traditions.VUL: Tulérunt ergo spólia multa ,
traditions.KJV: and they carried away very much spoil .

13.english_reference: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar ;

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּכּ֗וּ אֵ֤ת כָּל הֶֽ עָרִים֙ סְבִיב֣וֹת גְּרָ֔ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατεδίωξεν Ἀσὰ καὶ ὁ λαὸς αὐτοῦ ἕως Γεδώρ ·
traditions.VUL: et percussérunt civitátes omnes per circúitum Geráræ :
traditions.KJV: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar ;

13.english_reference: for the fear of the LORD came upon them :

traditions.WLC: כִּי הָיָ֥ה פַֽחַד יְהוָ֖ה עֲלֵי הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔπεσον Αἰθίοπες ὥστε μὴ εἶναι ἐν αὐτοῖς περιποίησιν ,
traditions.VUL: grandis quippe cunctos terror inváserat :
traditions.KJV: for the fear of the LORD came upon them :

13.english_reference: and they spoiled all the cities ;

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹ֨זּוּ֙ אֶת כָּל הֶ֣ עָרִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: ὅτι συνετρίβησαν ἐνώπιον Κυρίου καὶ ἐναντίον τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: et diripuérunt urbes ,
traditions.KJV: and they spoiled all the cities ;

13.english_reference: for there was exceeding much spoil in them .

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי בִזָּ֥ה רַבָּ֖ה הָיְתָ֥ה בָ הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐσκύλευσαν σκῦλα πολλά .
traditions.VUL: et multam prædam asportavérunt .
traditions.KJV: for there was exceeding much spoil in them .

14.english_reference: They smote also the tents of cattle ,

traditions.WLC: וְ גַם אָהֳלֵ֥י מִקְנֶ֖ה הִכּ֑וּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξέκοψαν τὰς κώμας αὐτῶν κύκλῳ Γεδώρ ,
traditions.VUL: Sed et caulas óvium destruéntes ,
traditions.KJV: They smote also the tents of cattle ,

14.english_reference: and carried away sheep and camels in abundance ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁבּ֨וּ צֹ֤אן לָ רֹב֙ וּ גְמַלִּ֔ים
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐγενήθη ἔκστασις Κυρίου ἐπ᾽ αὐτούς ,
traditions.VUL: tulérunt pécorum infinítam multitúdinem , et camelórum :
traditions.KJV: and carried away sheep and camels in abundance ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּשֻׁ֖בוּ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐσκύλευσαν πάσας τὰς πόλεις αὐτοῦ , ὅτι πολλὰ σκῦλα ἐγενήθη αὐτοῖς ·
traditions.VUL: reversíque sunt in Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: and returned to Jerusalem .
